headline: Kewaunee Scientific Enters Agreement to Acquire Nycom
summary: Kewaunee Scientific Corporation entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Nycom, Inc., described as the largest lab dealer in the USA.
why: Kewaunee Scientific Corporation manufactures laboratory furniture and infrastructure. Acquisitions of key dealers or suppliers can expand market share and distribution capabilities.

impacts.name: Kewaunee Scientific Corporation
impacts.why: Acquiring Nycom expands Kewaunee's position as a lab dealer network in the US.
